mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, ( SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT P JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE' AND LOWER(P.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE' AND LOWER(P.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
